name: Universal Cookie Banner Killer
description: Auto-dismisses GDPR/cookie consent banners across thousands of sites using common CMP frameworks

params.code: var btns = document.querySelectorAll('[id*="cookie"] button, [class*="cookie"] button, [id*="consent"] button, [class*="consent"] button, [id*="gdpr"] button, [class*="gdpr"] button, [class*="cc-btn"], .cc-accept, .cc-dismiss, #onetrust-accept-btn-handler, .onetrust-accept-btn-handler, #CybotCookiebotDialogBodyLevelButtonLevelOptinAllowAll, #CybotCookiebotDialogBodyButtonAccept, .cmpboxbtn.cmpboxbtnyes, #didomi-notice-agree-button, .qc-cmp2-summary-buttons button:first-child, [data-testid="cookie-policy-manage-dialog-btn-accept"], .js-accept-cookies, .accept-cookies, [aria-label*="Accept"][aria-label*="cookie"], [aria-label*="accept"][aria-label*="cookie"], button[data-cookiebanner="accept_button"]'); for (var b of btns) { if (b.offsetParent !== null) { b.click(); break; } } return btns.length.toString();

params.css: body.cookie-modal-open, body.modal-open, body.no-scroll { overflow: auto !important; position: static !important; } .cc-overlay, [class*='cookie-overlay'], [class*='consent-overlay'] { display: none !important; }
